slides.title: I listen.
slides.subtitle: Ometz Dental is the practice of Dr. Gabriella González Pane. Twenty years of experience in oral rehabilitation, aesthetics, and operative dentistry. Diagnosis before any procedure. A written plan. A clear explanation. You decide with information, not fear.

slides.title: Oral rehabilitation — when the mouth needs a plan, not patches
slides.subtitle: It's not 'fixing a tooth.' It's looking at the whole mouth, understanding what happened, and building a plan that makes clinical, functional, and economic sense. For patients with accumulated treatment, failed procedures, complex cases.

slides.title: Written second opinion, no obligation
slides.subtitle: Another dentist recommended an important treatment. Before accepting, we review your case with no conflict of interest. If you don't need treatment, we'll say so.
